what: Each text line holds two copies of the same text stacked, when the panel enters the middle 40% of the screen, the faint copy (opacity .2) is written in from the left via clip-path, and .8s later the dark copy covers it along the same path — like drawing once lightly and once heavily with a pen. Line duration is max(.65, line width ÷ 195) seconds so longer lines go slower, .15s between lines and .4s between groups (Japanese · English). The curve is a custom one that starts fast and settles long (0.083,0.294 0.134,0.56 0.338,0.782 0.48,0.937 0.752,1)

options.rate: Value to divide line width by (px/sec) — line length = Width ÷ rate, default 195
options.group: Delay between groups (seconds), default .4 — each group’s data-delay (seconds) is also added up from the front
options.lag: Seconds from the faint layer to the bold layer, default .8
options.margin: IntersectionObserver rootMargin, default -30% 0px (triggers when it reaches the middle, excluding 30% at the top and bottom of the screen)
options.ease: Curve — four Béziers, SVG path, or GSAP name, default is the original path (power2.out if CustomEase is missing)
options.[data-fx-part=group]: Line groups (optional) — like three Japanese lines and three English lines. If omitted, the whole element is one group
options.[data-fx-part=line]: One line (element containing text only) — line breaks are written as separate lines
